name: Clubhouse WG20
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Clubhouse WG20 in Innsbruck – your gateway to unforgettable adventures in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alpenland**, our cozy clubhouse offers the perfect mix of relaxation and excitement. Whether you're here for the **Nordkette**’s breathtaking views, the charm of **Altstadt Innsbruck**, or the thrill of skiing in **Axamer Lizum**, we’ve got you covered.

**Why stay with us?**
✔ **Prime location** – Just steps from Innsbruck’s vibrant city center and easy access to the **Innsbrucker Bergbahnen** funicular.
✔ **Authentic Tiroler hospitality** – Savor a hearty breakfast with **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Speckknödel**, or a steaming **Kaffee mit Schlag** on our sunny terrace.
✔ **Adventure hub** – From hiking in the **Karwendel** to après-ski in **Hungerburg**, we’ll help you make the most of your time in Tirol.
✔ **Social vibe** – Meet fellow travelers, swap stories, and plan your next escapade over a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudelwein**.

**What’s nearby?**
🚡 **Nordkettebahn** – Ride Europe’s longest reversible cable car for panoramic views.
🏔️ **Hafelekar** – Tirol’s highest accessible peak, perfect for sunrise hikes.
🍽️ **Gasthof Weisses Rössl** – Try **Tiroler Gröstl** or **Käsespätzle** in this historic inn.
🎿 **Skigebiet Patscherkofel** – A short bus ride away for world-class skiing and snowboarding.

**Book your stay today and let the magic of Tirol unfold!**
